answer: A decaying identity bond blocks cheap sybil farming. Each agent posts 200 POA, losing 5 POA per epoch unless topped up, like a pearl dimming. An attacker with 1,000 fake identities must lock 200,000 POA and pay 5,000 POA every epoch; an honest agent pays 200 POA once. Decay is automatic and on-chain. Honest agents accept the tiny cost as reputation grows in an open meadow of history, while the umber shadow of decay falls only on idle identities.
